styleLock.backgroundSystem: deep graphite gradient stage #14141C with a faint mirror reflection for heroes, alternating with clean off-white spec and infographic panels #EDEDEA; the same material language runs across the whole set
styleLock.lightingSystem: cool neutral studio light around 5600K with a strong directional side and rim raking key that sculpts the polished steel, plus a soft fill on the shadow side and a real grounding contact shadow
styleLock.surfaceSystem: brushed and mirror-finished machined steel, presented on matte graphite #14141C or matte off-white #EDEDEA surfaces
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif; headlines and short labels in deep charcoal #2D2D2D on light panels or #EDEDEA on dark panels, set inside #C8102E pill label chips; no serif, handwritten, retro or cartoon faces
styleLock.iconSystem: thin monoline #EDEDEA line icons at a single consistent stroke weight, paired with short labels; #C8102E pill chips for callouts
styleLock.presentationRules: true circular ring geometry with no ellipse distortion, stable centre placement, consistent 3/4 hero angle across the set, polished steel speculars always legible, separable parts shown with logical gravity and contact shadows
noDrift: no brand logo, wordmark, watermark or QR code
no invented certification seals, ratings, lab numbers or origin claims
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium industrial-hardware e-commerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of deep graphite base #14141C, clean off-white panel #EDEDEA, brushed-steel neutral #B7BCC2, and one accent #C8102E; cool neutral studio lighting around 5600K; modern geometric sans-serif; thin monoline line-icon style with #C8102E pill label chips; machined polished-steel product rendered with crisp specular highlights and true circular geometry; consistent directional side and rim raking light revealing the ball set, raceways and cage; stable product scale and centering; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

provenance.notes: 主体判读：平面推力球轴承（轴圈+座圈+钢球保持架的可分离结构）详情页长图切片，共 11 片，已逐片读取（panel-01 至 panel-11），未读取源长图整图。源夹名为「五金」，实际归档夹为 _sources\平面推力球轴，夹名与实物不冲突，实物以图为准。类目就近归类理由：category-taxonomy.md 全部 L2 中无「轴承」也无「工业传动件/机械零件」项，最贴近的既有 L2 为 家装灯具 → 五金（金属零部件/五金件桶），故按就近原则取 L1=家装灯具、L2=五金（两值逐字符取自 taxonomy），leaf 用自由文本=平面推力球轴承；taxonomy 缺理想工业类目属已知局限，若后续扩类目应改挂工业/MRO 大类。脱原图处理：已剥离素材站水印角标、行业领导者排行口吻、原产国与进口字样、与他品牌同类的对比句式、国际认证与100%达标字样、快递公司实名、二维码与会员招募模块、任何品牌/公司/人名/联系方式；型号 51200-51207 与内径/外径/宽度等全部数值改为 {callout_*} 占位符，模板不复现任何真实规格。源图 panel-06 至 panel-09 中的大面积空白灰框为模板待填占位，仅据其红色药丸标签推断为多角度/多规格展示位，未据其编造内容。未把源图的结论性话术当作事实沿用，只保留可视觉验证的钢球/滚道/保持架/钢材实物/无字包装作为信任载体，未编造认证、评分、检测数据或功效。视觉体系：深炭石墨舞台 #14141C + 浅灰信息面板 #EDEDEA + 强调色药丸 #C8102E + 细线单权重图标，统一侧光与掠射光以体现钢球、滚道、保持架与金属光泽。节奏：含 90 度俯视阵列与平铺、90 度侧视剖面、约 30 度与掠射两镜微距、低角度仰视与高 45 度俯视，机位角 6 类以上，无三连同角，无 35-40% 档全景镜头（全景占比 0%，满足 ≤40%），开 HERO 收 CTA。
